# Setup

```{r, include = FALSE}
#Loading packages
library(readxl)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lme4)
library(nlme)

library(lmerTest)

#To clear the workspace
rm(list = ls(all = T))

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy = TRUE, message=FALSE)

# My theme
theme.dgm <- function () {
  theme_classic(base_size = 12, 
           base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
}

theme.dgm.map <- function (){
  theme_bw(base_size = 12, 
           base_family = "serif") +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) 
}


#Loading the data
phys_char_initial <- read.csv(here("03_cleaned_data", 
                                   "SeaStar_Physical_Characteristics_wAssignments.csv"))

phys_char_final<- read_excel(here("01_raw_data",
                             "SeaStar_Physical_Characteristics.xlsx"))

right_raw <- read_excel(here("01_raw_data",
                             "Experiment_Data.xlsx"), sheet = "Righting")

feeding_raw <- read_excel(here("01_raw_data",
                             "Experiment_Data.xlsx"), sheet = "Feeding")

extractions_raw <- read_excel(here("01_raw_data",
                             "Experiment_Data.xlsx"), sheet = "Extractions")

morts_raw <- read_excel(here("01_raw_data",
                             "Experiment_Data.xlsx"), sheet = "Mortalities")

AFDM_raw <- read_excel(here("01_raw_data",
                             "AFDM_measures.xlsx"), sheet = "Experiment")

cytes_raw <- read_excel(here("01_raw_data", 
                              "Coelomocyte_Counts.xlsx"),
                        sheet = "Counts")
```

```{r}
#updating the final values after QAQC was done

phys_char <- phys_char_initial %>%
  mutate(HeatTreatment_Replicate = phys_char_final$HeatTreatment_Replicate,
         Final_WetWeight_g = phys_char_final$Final_WetWeight_g,
         Final_Radius_mm = phys_char_final$Final_Radius_mm, 
         Final_Size_Class = phys_char_final$Final_Size_Class,
         Final_Weight_Class = phys_char_final$Final_Weight_Class) %>%
  mutate(Heat_Treatment = factor(Heat_Treatment,
                                 levels = c("AFDM baseline", "control", "mid", "high"),
                                 labels = c("AFDM baseline",
                                            "15°C - Control",
                                            "20°C - Mid",
                                            "25°C - High")),
         Food_Treatment = factor(Food_Treatment,
                                 levels = c("fed", "unfed"),
                                 labels = c("Access\nto food", "No access\nto food")))
  
```

# Changes in physical traits

## Inital radii measures

```{r}
radii_before <- phys_char %>%
  filter(!is.na(Food_Treatment)) %>%
  reframe(mean = mean(Initial_Radius_mm),
            se = sd(Initial_Radius_mm)/sqrt(length(Initial_Radius_mm)))
```

## Change in radius

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}

experimental_stars <- phys_char %>%
  filter(!is.na(Food_Treatment) & 
           Food_Treatment != "AFDM baseline") %>%
  mutate(diff_radius = Final_Radius_mm - Initial_Radius_mm,
         diff_wet_weight = Final_WetWeight_g - Initial_WetWeight_g) 

experimental_stars_surv <- experimental_stars %>%
  filter(is.na(Final_Radius_mm) == FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Food_Heat_inter = paste(Food_Treatment, Heat_Treatment),
         Food_Heat_inter = factor(Food_Heat_inter, 
                                  levels = c("Access\nto food 15°C - Control", 
                                             "No access\nto food 15°C - Control",
                                             "Access\nto food 20°C - Mid",
                                             "No access\nto food 20°C - Mid",
                                             "Access\nto food 25°C - High",
                                             "No access\nto food 25°C - High")))

(arm_radius_boxplot <- ggplot(experimental_stars_surv, 
                              aes(x = Food_Treatment, y = diff_radius, fill = Heat_Treatment)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme.dgm() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4472CA", "gold", "salmon")) +
  labs(x = "\nFood Access Treatment", y = "Change in arm radius (mm)\n", fill = "Aquaria\nTemperature\nTreatment") +
  theme(legend.position = "top"))

```


### Models

```{r, fig.show='hide'}
# hist(experimental_stars_surv$diff_radius)
experimental_stars_surv <- droplevels(experimental_stars_surv)

diff_radius_mod_full <- glmmTMB(diff_radius ~ Food_Treatment*Heat_Treatment + (1 | Mesocosm_Number), 
                        data = experimental_stars_surv)

plot(simulateResiduals(diff_radius_mod_full))
# summary(diff_radius_mod_full)
```

```{r, fig.show='hide'}
diff_radius_mod_no_re <- glmmTMB(diff_radius ~ Food_Treatment*Heat_Treatment, 
                        data = experimental_stars_surv)

plot(simulateResiduals(diff_radius_mod_no_re))
# summary(diff_radius_mod_no_re)
```

```{r, fig.show='hide'}
diff_radius_mod_no_inter <- glmmTMB(diff_radius ~ Food_Treatment+Heat_Treatment, 
                        data = experimental_stars_surv)

plot(simulateResiduals(diff_radius_mod_no_inter))
# summary(diff_radius_mod_no_inter)
```

#### AICc

```{r}
AICc(diff_radius_mod_full, diff_radius_mod_no_re, diff_radius_mod_no_inter) %>%
  arrange(AICc) %>%
  mutate(Delta_AICc = AICc - min(AICc)) %>%
  kable(digits = 2, align = "c", caption = "Difference in Radius Models") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
```

#### Best Model

```{r}
summary(diff_radius_mod_no_inter)
```

```{r}

CI_diff_radius_mod_no_inter <- tidy(diff_radius_mod_no_inter, effects = "fixed", 
                                      conf.int = TRUE, conf.method = "profile") %>%
  mutate(significance = if_else(conf.low > 0 | conf.high < 0, "Sig", "No Sig"),
         significance = factor(significance, levels = c("Sig", "No Sig")))%>%
  mutate(term = case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)" ~ "Intercept",
    term == "Food_TreatmentNo access\nto food" ~  "No access to food",                         
    term == "Heat_Treatment20°C - Mid" ~ "20°C - Mid",
    term == "Heat_Treatment25°C - High" ~ "25°C - High",
    term == "Food_TreatmentNo access\nto food:Heat_Treatment20°C - Mid" ~ "No access to food:\n20°C - Mid",
    term == "Food_TreatmentNo access\nto food:Heat_Treatment25°C - High" ~ "No access to food:\n25°C - High"
  ))


(plot_CI_diff_radius_mod_no_inter <- ggplot(CI_diff_radius_mod_no_inter, 
                                           aes(x = estimate, 
                                               y = reorder(term, estimate), 
                                               color = significance)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2, linewidth = 1)  +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("palevioletred", "black")) +
  theme.dgm() +
  labs(x = "\nModel Estimates (± CI)", y = "Predictor Variables\n") +
  theme(legend.position = "none"))

```

# AFDM

```{r}

treatment_assignments <- phys_char %>%
  dplyr::select(SeaStar_ID, Food_Treatment, Heat_Treatment, Mesocosm_Number)

AFDM_clean <- AFDM_raw %>%
  filter(is.na(SeaStar_ID) == FALSE) %>%
  mutate(ID_GB = paste(.$SeaStar_ID, .$Gonad_or_Body, sep = "_")) %>%
  group_by(SeaStar_ID, Gonad_or_Body, ID_GB) %>%
  summarise(Dry_mass_g = sum(Dry_mass_g),
            Ash_mass_g = sum(Ash_mass_g),
            AFDM_g = sum(AFDM_g), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(treatment_assignments, by = "SeaStar_ID") %>%
  mutate(Heat_Treatment = factor(Heat_Treatment,
                                 levels = c("AFDM baseline",
                                            "15°C - Control",
                                            "20°C - Mid",
                                            "25°C - High"),
                                 labels = c("Pre-experiment Control",
                                            "15°C - Control",
                                            "20°C - Mid",
                                            "25°C - High")),
         Food_Treatment = if_else(is.na(Food_Treatment) == TRUE, 
                                  "Pre-experiment\nControl", Food_Treatment),
         Food_Treatment = factor(Food_Treatment,
                                 levels = c("Pre-experiment\nControl",
                                            "Access\nto food", 
                                            "No access\nto food")),
        Gonad_or_Body = factor(Gonad_or_Body, 
                               levels = c("B", "G"),
                               labels = c("Body Tissue", "Gonad Tissue")))

AFDM_clean_ratio <- AFDM_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(-Dry_mass_g, -Ash_mass_g, -ID_GB) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Gonad_or_Body, values_from = AFDM_g) %>%
  rename(Gonad_AFDM = 'Gonad Tissue',
         Body_AFDM = 'Body Tissue') %>%
  mutate(ratio = Gonad_AFDM / Body_AFDM,
         combo = paste(Food_Treatment, Heat_Treatment),
         combo = factor(combo, levels = c("Pre-experiment\nControl Pre-experiment Control",
                                          "Access\nto food 15°C - Control",
                                          "No access\nto food 15°C - Control",
                                          "Access\nto food 20°C - Mid",
                                          "No access\nto food 20°C - Mid",
                                          "Access\nto food 25°C - High",
                                          "No access\nto food 25°C - High"),
                        labels = c("Pre-experiment\nControl",
                                   "Access\nto food &\n15°C - Control",
                                   "No access\nto food &\n15°C - Control",
                                   "Access\nto food &\n20°C - Mid",
                                   "No access\nto food &\n20°C - Mid",
                                   "Access\nto food &\n25°C - High",
                                   "No access\nto food &\n25°C - High")))

AFDM_total <- AFDM_clean %>%
  group_by(SeaStar_ID, Food_Treatment, Heat_Treatment, Mesocosm_Number) %>%
  summarise(Dry_mass_g = sum(Dry_mass_g),
            Ash_mass_g = sum(Ash_mass_g),
            AFDM_g = sum(AFDM_g),
            Gonad_or_Body = "Total",
            ID_GB = NA, .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::select(SeaStar_ID, Gonad_or_Body, ID_GB, Dry_mass_g, Ash_mass_g, AFDM_g, 
                Food_Treatment, Heat_Treatment, Mesocosm_Number)

AFDM_clean_wtotal <- rbind(AFDM_clean, AFDM_total)
  
```

```{r, eval = FALSE}
sample_sizes_afdm <- AFDM_clean %>%
  group_by(Heat_Treatment, Food_Treatment) %>%
  summarize(sample_size = length(unique(SeaStar_ID)))

sample_sizes_afdm
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}

(AFDM_separated_boxplot <- ggplot(AFDM_clean_wtotal, 
                             aes(x = Food_Treatment, y = AFDM_g, fill = Heat_Treatment)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme.dgm() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkgrey", "#4472CA", "gold", "salmon"))+
  labs(x = "\nFood Access Treatment", y = "AFDM (g)\n", fill = "Temperature Treatment") +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  facet_wrap(~Gonad_or_Body, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y")) 

```


## Testing baseline

```{r, fig.show='hide'}

  filter(Food_Treatment == "Pre-experiment\nControl" |
         (Food_Treatment == "Access\nto food" & Heat_Treatment == "15°C - Control"))

afdm_baseline_mod <- glmmTMB(ratio ~ Food_Treatment, 
                data = AFDM_clean_ratio_baseline, 
                family = beta_family(link = "logit"))

plot(simulateResiduals(afdm_baseline_mod))
```

##### Metrics of change

```{r}

AFDM_mod_sum <- AFDM_clean_ratio_nobaseline %>%
  group_by(Heat_Treatment) %>%
  summarize(mean_prop = mean(ratio),
            se_prop = sd(ratio) / sqrt(length(ratio)))

# 15 - 25 Fold change
(AFDM_mod_sum$mean_prop[1] - AFDM_mod_sum$mean_prop[3])/AFDM_mod_sum$mean_prop[1]
```

```{r}

CI_afdm_mod_best <- tidy(afdm_mod_best, effects = "fixed", 
                                      conf.int = TRUE, conf.method = "profile") %>%
  mutate(significance = if_else(conf.low > 0 | conf.high < 0, "Sig", "No Sig"),
         significance = factor(significance, levels = c("Sig", "No Sig"))) %>%
  mutate(term = case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)" ~ "Intercept",
    term == "Food_TreatmentNo access\nto food" ~  "No access to food",                         
    term == "Heat_Treatment20°C - Mid" ~ "20°C - Mid",
    term == "Heat_Treatment25°C - High" ~ "25°C - High"
  ), 
  term = factor(term, levels = c("25°C - High",
                                 "20°C - Mid",
                                 "No access to food",
                                 "Intercept")))


(plot_CI_afdm_mod_best <- ggplot(CI_afdm_mod_best, 
                                           aes(x = estimate, 
                                               y = term, 
                                               color = significance)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2, linewidth = 1)  +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("palevioletred", "black")) +
  theme.dgm() +
  labs(x = "\n\nModel Estimates (± CI)", y = "Predictor Variables\n") +
  theme(legend.position = "none"))

```

# Righting Response

```{r}

right_clean <- right_raw %>%
  left_join(AFDM_clean_ratio_nobaseline, by = c("SeaStar_ID"), suffix = c("", ".y")) %>%
  mutate(AFDM_Total_g = Body_AFDM + Gonad_AFDM) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Food_Treatment, Heat_Treatment, Mesocosm_Number.y, Body_AFDM, 
  Gonad_AFDM, ratio)) %>%
  mutate(Tube_Feet_Movement = ifelse(Tube_Feet_Movement == TRUE, 1, 0),
         Arm_Movement = ifelse(Arm_Movement == TRUE, 1, 0),
         Arm_On_Substrate = ifelse(Arm_On_Substrate == TRUE, 1, 0),
         Started_to_Right = ifelse(Started_to_Right == TRUE, 1, 0),
         Righted = ifelse(Righted == TRUE, 1, 0),
         Time_initiate_mins_clean = as.numeric(as.difftime(Time_initiate_minsec,
                                            format="%M:%S", unit = "mins")),
         Time_initiate_sec = Time_initiate_mins_clean * 60,
         Time_right_mins_clean = ifelse(Time_right_minsec == "DNF", NA, 
                                        as.numeric(as.difftime(Time_right_minsec,
                                            format="%M:%S", unit = "mins"))),
         Time_right_sec = Time_right_mins_clean * 60,
         Mesocosm_Number = as.factor(Mesocosm_Number)) %>%
  left_join(treatment_assignments, by = join_by(SeaStar_ID == SeaStar_ID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Mesocosm_Number.x) %>%
  rename(Mesocosm_Number = Mesocosm_Number.y) %>%
  mutate(Heat_Treatment = factor(Heat_Treatment,
                                 levels = c("15°C - Control",
                                            "20°C - Mid",
                                            "25°C - High"),
                                 labels = c("15°C - Control",
                                            "20°C - Mid",
                                            "25°C - High")),
         Food_Treatment = factor(Food_Treatment,
                                 levels = c("Access\nto food", 
                                            "No access\nto food")),
         Timepoint = as.factor(Timepoint),
         Timepoint_cont = case_when(
         Timepoint == "T1" ~ 0,
         Timepoint == "T2" ~ 5,
         Timepoint == "T3" ~ 10,
         Timepoint == "T4" ~ 15
         )) 

```

```{r}

right_props <- right_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(SeaStar_ID, Timepoint, Heat_Treatment, Food_Treatment, Tube_Feet_Movement,

  group_by(Timepoint, Heat_Treatment, Food_Treatment) %>%
```

## Survival Model

```{r}
righted_surv_df <- right_clean %>%
  mutate(righted_censor = if_else(is.na(Time_right_mins_clean) == TRUE, 0, 1), 
         Time_right_mins_clean = if_else(is.na(Time_right_mins_clean) == TRUE, 
                                  15, Time_right_mins_clean)) %>%
  dplyr::select(SeaStar_ID, Time_right_mins_clean, righted_censor, Timepoint, 
                Timepoint_cont, Heat_Treatment, Food_Treatment, Mesocosm_Number) %>%
  mutate(Heat_Treatment = factor(Heat_Treatment, levels = c("15°C - Control", 
                                                            "20°C - Mid",
                                                            "25°C - High"),
                                 labels = c("15°C\nControl", "20°C\nMid",
                                            "25°C\nHigh")),
         Food_Treatment = factor(Food_Treatment,
                                 levels = c("Access\nto food", 
                                            "No access\nto food"))) %>%
  left_join(AFDM_clean_ratio_nobaseline, by = c("SeaStar_ID"), suffix = c("", ".y")) %>%
  mutate(AFDM_Total_g = Body_AFDM + Gonad_AFDM,
         Mesocosm_Number = as.factor(Mesocosm_Number),
         SeaStar_ID = as.factor(SeaStar_ID)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Food_Treatment.y, Heat_Treatment.y, Mesocosm_Number.y, Body_AFDM, 
  Gonad_AFDM, ratio)) %>%
  mutate(combo = paste(Heat_Treatment, Food_Treatment, sep = "\n"),
         combo = factor(combo, 
                        levels = c("15°C\nControl\nAccess\nto food",
                                   "15°C\nControl\nNo access\nto food",
                                   "20°C\nMid\nNo access\nto food",
                                   "20°C\nMid\nAccess\nto food",
                                   "25°C\nHigh\nAccess\nto food",
                                   "25°C\nHigh\nNo access\nto food"),
                        labels = c("15°C - Control\nAccess to food",
                                   "15°C - Control\nNo access to food",
                                   "20°C - Mid\nNo access to food",
                                   "20°C - Mid\nAccess to food",
                                   "25°C - High\nAccess to food",
                                   "25°C - High\nNo access to food")))

righted_surv_df <- droplevels(righted_surv_df)
```

```{r}
right_gam_mod_ests <- as.data.frame(summary(right_gam_oneinter)$p.table) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "term") %>%
  rename(Std.Error = "Std. Error") %>%
  mutate(conf.low = Estimate - (1.96*Std.Error),
         conf.high = Estimate + (1.96*Std.Error)) %>%
  mutate(significance = if_else(conf.low > 0 | conf.high < 0, "Sig", "No Sig"),
         significance = factor(significance, levels = c("Sig", "No Sig"))) %>%
  mutate(term = case_when(
    term == "Food_TreatmentNo access\nto food" ~  "No access\nto food",            
    term == "Heat_Treatment20°C\nMid" ~ "20°C - Mid",
    term == "Heat_Treatment25°C\nHigh" ~ "25°C - High",
    term == "Food_TreatmentNo access\nto food:Heat_Treatment20°C\nMid" ~ "No access\nto food:\n20°C - Mid",
    term == "Food_TreatmentNo access\nto food:Heat_Treatment25°C\nHigh" ~ "No access\nto food:\n25°C - High",
    term == "scale(AFDM_Total_g)" ~ "AFDM",
    term == "scale(Timepoint_cont)" ~ "Experimental Day"
    ),
    term = factor(term, levels = c("Experimental Day",
                                   "AFDM", 
                                   "No access\nto food:\n25°C - High",
                                   "No access\nto food:\n20°C - Mid",
                                   "25°C - High",
                                   "20°C - Mid",
                                   "No access\nto food")))


(plot_right_gam_mod_ests <- ggplot(right_gam_mod_ests, 
                                           aes(x = Estimate, 
                                               y = term, 
                                               color = significance)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2, linewidth = 1)  +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("palevioletred", "black")) +
  theme.dgm() +
  labs(x = "\nEstimate", y = "Predictor") +
```

# Feeding Rates

## Over Time

```{r}

classifications <- phys_char %>%
  dplyr::select(SeaStar_ID, Food_Treatment, Heat_Treatment)

feeding_clean <- feeding_raw %>%
  dplyr::select(-HeatTreatment_Replicate) %>%
  left_join(classifications, by = "SeaStar_ID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Food_Treatment) & 
           Food_Treatment != "AFDM baseline") %>%
  mutate(Ratio_Ate = as.numeric(Ratio_Ate),
         Heat_Colors = case_when(
           Heat_Treatment == "15°C - Control" ~ "#4472CA",
           Heat_Treatment == "20°C - Mid" ~ "gold",
           Heat_Treatment == "25°C - High" ~ "salmon"
         ),
         Phase = case_when(
           Timepoint %in% c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4") ~ "PreExperiment",
           Timepoint %in% c("T1", "T2", "T2-T3", "T3", "T4") ~ "Experiment"
         ))

```


### Rates

```{r}

feeding_experiments <- feeding_clean %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("T1", "T2", "T2-T3", "T3", "T4") &
         Food_Treatment == "Access\nto food" &
         is.na(Number_Ate) == FALSE &
         is.na(Ratio_Ate) == FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Day_cont = case_when(
           Timepoint == "T1" ~ 0,
           Timepoint == "T2" ~ 5,
           Timepoint == "T3" ~ 10,
           Timepoint == "T4" ~ 15,
           Timepoint == "T2-T3" ~7
         ))


feeding_rate_df <- data.frame()

for(i in 1:length(unique(feeding_experiments$SeaStar_ID))){
  
  xx_df <- feeding_experiments %>%
    filter(SeaStar_ID == unique(feeding_experiments$SeaStar_ID)[i])
  
  xx_cor <- cor.test(xx_df$Day_cont, xx_df$Ratio_Ate, method = "spearman")
  
  xx_values <- data.frame(SeaStar_ID = unique(feeding_experiments$SeaStar_ID)[i], 
                          Heat_Treatment = xx_df$Heat_Treatment[1],
                          Rho = xx_cor$estimate)
  row.names(xx_values) <- NULL
  
  feeding_rate_df <- rbind(feeding_rate_df, xx_values)
  
}

feeding_rate_df[is.na(feeding_rate_df)] <- 0


```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}

(rate_feeding_boxplot <- ggplot(feeding_rate_df, 
                             aes(x = Heat_Treatment, y = Rho, fill = Heat_Treatment)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme.dgm() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4472CA", "gold", "salmon"))+
  labs(x = "\nAquariaTemperature Treatment", y = "Correlation of Mussel Consumption Over Time\n") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")) 

```


### Model

```{r}
# hist(feeding_rate_df$Rho)

feeding_rate_mod <- kruskal.test(Rho ~ Heat_Treatment,
                      data = feeding_rate_df)

feeding_rate_mod

dunn.test(feeding_rate_df$Rho, feeding_rate_df$Heat_Treatment, method = "bonferroni")

dunn.test(feeding_rate_df$Rho, feeding_rate_df$Heat_Treatment, method = "hs")

dunn.test(feeding_rate_df$Rho, feeding_rate_df$Heat_Treatment, method = "bh")

dunn.test(feeding_rate_df$Rho, feeding_rate_df$Heat_Treatment, method = "by")


```

# Change in Coelomocytes

```{r}

Cytes_clean <- as.data.frame(matrix(data = NA, nrow = 480, ncol = 5))
                          
colnames(Cytes_clean) <- c("SeaStar_ID", "Food_Treatment", "Heat_Treatment", 
                            "Timepoint", "Coelomocyte_Count")

Cytes_clean$SeaStar_ID <- rep(experimental_stars$SeaStar_ID, 4)
Cytes_clean$Food_Treatment <- rep(experimental_stars$Food_Treatment, 4)
Cytes_clean$Heat_Treatment <- rep(experimental_stars$Heat_Treatment, 4)
Cytes_clean$Timepoint <- c(rep("T1", 120), rep("T2", 120), rep("T3", 120), rep("T4", 120))

for(i in 1:nrow(Cytes_clean)) {
  
  xx_key <-  filter(extractions_raw, SeaStar_ID == Cytes_clean$SeaStar_ID[i] & 
                      Timepoint == Cytes_clean$Timepoint[i])$CC_Extraction_ID[1]
  
  xx_count <- cytes_raw %>%
    filter(Extraction_ID == xx_key)
  
  if(nrow(xx_count) == 0){
    next
  }
  
  Cytes_clean$Coelomocyte_Count[i] <- xx_count$Count
}

Cytes_cleaner <- Cytes_clean %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("T1", "T2", "T3", "T4")),
         Coelomocyte_Count = as.numeric(Coelomocyte_Count),
         Day_cont = case_when(
           Timepoint == "T1" ~ 0,
           Timepoint == "T2" ~ 5,
           Timepoint == "T3" ~ 10,
           Timepoint == "T4" ~ 15
         ), 
         Day_cont = as.numeric(Day_cont),
         Day_cont_cat = case_when(
           Timepoint == "T1" ~ "Day 0",
           Timepoint == "T2" ~ "Day 5",
           Timepoint == "T3" ~ "Day 10",
           Timepoint == "T4" ~ "Day 15"
         ),
         Day_cont_cat = factor(Day_cont_cat, levels = c("Day 0", "Day 5", "Day 10", "Day 15"))) %>%
  left_join(phys_char, by = join_by(SeaStar_ID == SeaStar_ID,
                                    Food_Treatment == Food_Treatment,
                                    Heat_Treatment == Heat_Treatment)) %>%
  mutate(Mesocosm_Number = as.factor(Mesocosm_Number)) %>%
  left_join(AFDM_clean_ratio_nobaseline, by = c("SeaStar_ID"), suffix = c("", ".y")) %>%
  mutate(AFDM_Total_g = Body_AFDM + Gonad_AFDM) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Food_Treatment.y, Heat_Treatment.y, Mesocosm_Number.y, Body_AFDM, 
  Gonad_AFDM, ratio)) 


```



```{r}

Change_Cytes <- Cytes_cleaner %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-Day_cont, -Day_cont_cat) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = Coelomocyte_Count, names_from = Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(T2_corr = T2-T1,
         T3_corr = T3-T1,
         T4_corr = T4-T1) %>%
  dplyr::select(-T1, -T2, -T3, -T4) %>%
  pivot_longer(values_to = "Coelomocyte_Count", names_to = "Timepoint", 
               cols = c(T2_corr, T3_corr, T4_corr)) %>%
  mutate(Day_cont = case_when(
           Timepoint == "T2_corr" ~ 5,
           Timepoint == "T3_corr" ~ 10,
           Timepoint == "T4_corr" ~ 15
         ), 
         Day_cont = as.numeric(Day_cont),
         Day_cont_cat = case_when(
           Timepoint == "T2_corr" ~ "Day 5",
           Timepoint == "T3_corr" ~ "Day 10",
           Timepoint == "T4_corr" ~ "Day 15"
         ),
         Day_cont_cat = factor(Day_cont_cat, levels = c("Day 5", "Day 10", "Day 15"))) 
  
```

```{r, fig.height=7, fig.width=7}
(coelomocyte_corr_boxplot <- ggplot(Change_Cytes, 
                             aes(x = Day_cont_cat, y = Coelomocyte_Count, fill = Heat_Treatment, 
                                 alpha = Food_Treatment)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
  theme.dgm() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#4472CA", "gold", "salmon")) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(1, 0.5)) +
  labs(alpha = "Access to\nFood", y = "Change in Coelomocyte Counts From Baseline\n", 
       fill = "Aquaria\nTemperature\nTreatment",
       x = "\nExperiment Day") +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  guides(alpha = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "darkgrey"))))


```

```{r}

CI_cytes_change_best_mod <- tidy(cytes_change_best_mod, effects = "fixed", 
                                      conf.int = TRUE, conf.method = "profile") %>%
  mutate(significance = if_else(conf.low > 0 | conf.high < 0, "Sig", "No Sig"),
         significance = factor(significance, levels = c("Sig", "No Sig"))) %>%
  mutate(term = case_when(
    term == "(Intercept)" ~ "Intercept",
    term == "Food_TreatmentNo access\nto food" ~  "No access to food",            
    term == "Heat_Treatment20°C - Mid" ~ "20°C - Mid",
    term == "Heat_Treatment25°C - High" ~ "25°C - High",
    term == "scale(Day_cont)" ~ "Experiment Day",
    term == "scale(AFDM_Total_g)" ~ "AFDM",
    term == "Food_TreatmentNo access\nto food:Heat_Treatment20°C - Mid" ~ "No access to food:\n20°C - Mid",
    term == "Food_TreatmentNo access\nto food:Heat_Treatment25°C - High" ~ "No access to food:\n25°C - High",
    term == "Food_TreatmentNo access\nto food:scale(Day_cont)" ~ "No access to food:\nExperiment Day",
    term == "Heat_Treatment20°C - Mid:scale(Day_cont)" ~ "20°C - Mid:\nExperiment Day",
    term == "Heat_Treatment25°C - High:scale(Day_cont)" ~ "25°C - High:\nExperiment Day"
  )) %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = c("25°C - High:\nExperiment Day", 
                                        "20°C - Mid:\nExperiment Day", 
                                        "No access to food:\nExperiment Day", 
                                        "No access to food:\n25°C - High", 
                                        "No access to food:\n20°C - Mid", 
                                        "AFDM", "Experiment Day", 
                                        "25°C - High", "20°C - Mid", 
                                        "No access to food", "Intercept")))


(plot_CI_cytes_change_best_mod <- ggplot(CI_cytes_change_best_mod, 
                                           aes(x = estimate, 
                                               y = term, 
                                               color = significance)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2, linewidth = 1)  +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("palevioletred", "black")) +
  theme.dgm() +
  labs(x = "\nModel Estimates (± CI)", y = "Predictor Variables\n") +
  theme(legend.position = "none"))

```

```{r, message = FALSE}
morts_clean <- morts_raw %>%

mort_surv_df <- experimental_stars %>%

  mutate(censor = case_when(
    is.na(Mort_Date) == TRUE ~ 0,
    is.na(Mort_Date) == FALSE ~ 1

  ),
  treatment = case_when(

    Heat_Treatment == "15°C - Control" &  
      Food_Treatment == "Access\nto food" ~ "Control Fed",
    Heat_Treatment == "20°C - Mid" &  
      Food_Treatment == "No access\nto food" ~ "Mid unFed",
    Heat_Treatment == "25°C - High" &  
      Food_Treatment == "No access\nto food" ~ "High unFed",
    Heat_Treatment == "15°C - Control" &  
      Food_Treatment == "No access\nto food" ~ "Control unFed"
  ), 
  treatment = as.factor(treatment)) %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment,
    levels = c("Control Fed", "Control unFed",

mort_surv <- Surv(mort_surv_df$Final_Date, mort_surv_df$censor)

)
```

## 50 m from shore and a depth of 1 m

From: <https://catalogue.hakai.org/erddap/files/HakaiQuadraBoLResearch/>
Metadata:
<https://catalogue.hakai.org/erddap/info/HakaiQuadraBoLResearch/index.html>

Data summary:

This dataset includes continuous sea surface measurements of partial
pressure of carbon dioxide (pCO2), sea surface temperature and salinity
collected from Hakai Institute Quadra Island Field Station in Hyacinthe
Bay, British Columbia, Canada. Quadra Island, at the northern terminus
of the Salish Sea, has been a site for shore-based and high-resolution
measurement of surface seawater CO2 content since December 2014.
Measurements of in situ temperature, salinity, and CO2 partial pressure
are made near-continuously on seawater drawn from a sample line with an
intake 50 m from shore and a depth of 1 m in Hyacinthe Bay on the
eastern side of Quadra Island. The effort to collect these data are part
of the Hakai Institute's directive to advance the understanding of
carbon cycling in northeast Pacific coastal settings with specific
emphasis on ocean acidification.

```{r}
Quadra_Seasonal_Temp_raw <- Quadra_CO2 %>%
  mutate(month = lubridate::month(date)) %>%
  mutate(season = case_when(
    month %in% c(1, 2, 12) ~ "Winter",
    month %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
    month %in% 5:8 ~ "Summer",
    month %in% 9:11 ~ "Fall"
  ),
  season = factor(season, levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Fall", "Winter"), 
                  labels = c("Spring\n(Mar-May)", "Summer\n(Jun-Aug)", 
                             "Fall\n(Sep-Nov)", "Winter\n(Dec-Feb)")))

Quadra_Seasonal_Temp_summarized <- Quadra_Seasonal_Temp_raw %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  summarize(season_temp_mean = mean(Temp_C, na.rm = TRUE),
            season_temp_mean_se = sd(Temp_C)/sqrt(length(Temp_C)),
            season_temp_max = max(Temp_C, na.rm = TRUE),
            season_temp_min = min(Temp_C, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") 
```

```{r}
env_temp_summary_quadra <- Quadra_Seasonal_Temp_summarized %>%
  mutate(source_name = "Hyacynthe Bay") %>%
  rename(subset = season,
         min = season_temp_min,
         mean = season_temp_mean,
         max = season_temp_max) %>%
  dplyr::select(source_name, subset, min, mean, max)

env_temp_summary <- rbind(env_temp_summary, env_temp_summary_quadra) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
konecny_heating <- read.csv(here("01_raw_data/Konecny_etal_2021", "01_Quadra_heatingData.csv")) %>%
```

```{r}
N_S_America_Shape <- rbind(ne_countries(continent = "North America", returnclass = "sf"), ne_countries(continent = "South America", returnclass = "sf"))

N_S_America_coastline <- st_transform(st_cast(N_S_America_Shape, "MULTILINESTRING"), 3857)

N_S_America_coastline_500m <- st_transform(st_buffer(N_S_America_coastline, dist = 1500), 4326)


N_America_bb <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -179, xmax = -106, ymin = 22.4, ymax = 62), crs = st_crs(4326))

Derm_Range <- st_crop(N_S_America_coastline_500m, N_America_bb)

biooracle_mean <- rast(brick(here("01_raw_data/biooracle", "thetao_baseline_2000_2019_depthsurf_74ff_39fa_9adc_U1745451895933.nc")), 
          crs="+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84")


N_America_BO_bb <- ext(-179, -106, 22.4, 60)
BO_temp_mean <- crop(biooracle_mean, N_America_BO_bb)

coastline_temp_mean <- extract(BO_temp_mean, Derm_Range, xy = TRUE) %>%
  na.omit()%>%
  mutate(variable = "mean",
         bin_lat = cut(y, breaks = c(60, 50, 40, 30, 20)))


biooracle_min <- rast(brick(here("01_raw_data/biooracle", "thetao_baseline_2000_2019_depthsurf_594f_268b_f266_U1748895182166.nc")), 
          crs="+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84")

BO_temp_min <- crop(biooracle_min, N_America_BO_bb)

coastline_temp_min <- extract(BO_temp_min, Derm_Range, xy = TRUE) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(variable = "min",
         bin_lat = cut(y, breaks = c(60, 50, 40, 30, 20)))


biooracle_max <- rast(brick(here("01_raw_data/biooracle", "thetao_baseline_2000_2019_depthsurf_4848_6062_6006_U1745451885320.nc")), 
          crs="+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84")

BO_temp_max <- crop(biooracle_max, N_America_BO_bb)

coastline_temp_max <- extract(BO_temp_max, Derm_Range, xy = TRUE) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(variable = "max",
         bin_lat = cut(y, breaks = c(60, 50, 40, 30, 20)))


coastline_temp_comb <- rbind(coastline_temp_mean, coastline_temp_max, coastline_temp_min) %>%
    dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
    rename(temp = X2010.01.01,
           latitude = y,
           longitude = x) %>%
    mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = c("min", "mean", "max")),
           area = case_when(
             bin_lat == "(20,30]" ~ "Baja\nCalifornia",
             bin_lat == "(30,40]" ~ "California",
             bin_lat == "(40,50]" ~ "Oregon,\nWashington &\nVancouver Island",
             bin_lat == "(50,60]" ~ "Northern BC &\nAlaska"
           ),
           area = factor(area, levels = c("Baja\nCalifornia",
                                          "California",
                                          "Oregon,\nWashington &\nVancouver Island",
                                          "Northern BC &\nAlaska")))

coastline_temp_max_clean <- coastline_temp_comb %>%
  filter(variable == "max")

coastline_temp_summary <- coastline_temp_comb %>%
  group_by(area, variable) %>%
  summarize(mean_temp = mean(temp),
            se_temp = sd(temp)/sqrt(length(temp)))
  
```



```{r}
env_temp_summary_satelite <- coastline_temp_summary %>%
  mutate(source_name = "Bio-ORACLE") %>%
  rename(subset = area) %>%
  dplyr::select(-se_temp) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = mean_temp)%>%
  dplyr::select(source_name, subset, min, mean, max)

env_temp_summary <- rbind(env_temp_summary, env_temp_summary_satelite) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(min = round(min, digits = 2),
         max = round(max, digits = 2),
         mean = round(mean, digits = 2))
```

# SEM

## Creating data set containing all variables

```{r}
Cytes_T4 <- Cytes_clean %>%
  filter(Timepoint == "T4") %>%
  dplyr::select(SeaStar_ID, Coelomocyte_Count)

right_T4 <- right_clean %>%
  filter(Timepoint == "T4") %>%
  dplyr::select(SeaStar_ID, Righted)
  

SEM_df <- AFDM_clean_ratio_nobaseline %>%
  mutate(AFDM_g = Body_AFDM + Gonad_AFDM) %>%
  left_join(Cytes_T4, by = "SeaStar_ID") %>%
  left_join(right_T4, by = "SeaStar_ID") %>%
  left_join(feeding_experiments_sum, by = c("SeaStar_ID", "Food_Treatment",
                                            "Heat_Treatment", "Mesocosm_Number")) %>%
  mutate(Mussels_Remaining = total_fed - total_ate,
         Coelomocyte_Count = as.numeric(Coelomocyte_Count),
         Mesocosm_Number = as.factor(Mesocosm_Number)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Body_AFDM, -Gonad_AFDM, -total_fed) %>%
  rename(Gonadosomatic_Ratio = ratio,
         Mussel_Prop_Consumed = Ratio_Ate,
         Mussels_Consumed = total_ate) 

SEM_df <- droplevels(SEM_df) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Coelomocyte_Count))

SEM_df_fed_sub <- SEM_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Mussel_Prop_Consumed))

SEM_df_clean <- SEM_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-Mussels_Consumed, -Mussel_Prop_Consumed, -Mussels_Remaining) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(Food_Treatment_binary = case_when(
     Food_Treatment == "Access\nto food"  ~ 1,
     Food_Treatment == "No access\nto food" ~ 0
  ),
  Heat_Treatment_num = case_when(
    Heat_Treatment == "15°C - Control" ~ 15,
    Heat_Treatment =="20°C - Mid" ~ 20,
    Heat_Treatment == "25°C - High" ~ 25
  ))
  
```

## Models

```{r, eval = FALSE}
body_cond_1_ALL <- lmer(AFDM_g ~ Food_Treatment_binary * Heat_Treatment_num + 
                        (1|Mesocosm_Number), data = SEM_df_clean)
# plot(simulateResiduals(body_cond_1_ALL))

body_cond_2_ALL <-  lmer(Gonadosomatic_Ratio ~ Food_Treatment_binary * 
                           Heat_Treatment_num  +
                        (1|Mesocosm_Number), data = SEM_df_clean)
# plot(simulateResiduals(body_cond_2_ALL))

body_cond_3_ALL <-  glmmTMB(Righted ~ Food_Treatment_binary * Heat_Treatment_num + 
                            AFDM_g + Coelomocyte_Count +
                            (1|Mesocosm_Number), data = SEM_df_clean,
                     family = binomial())
# plot(simulateResiduals(body_cond_3_ALL))

immune_system_ALL <- glmmTMB(Coelomocyte_Count ~ AFDM_g + Gonadosomatic_Ratio + 
                           Food_Treatment_binary * Heat_Treatment_num + 
                             (1|Mesocosm_Number),
                       family = poisson(), data = SEM_df_clean)
# plot(simulateResiduals(immune_system_ALL))

quadra_sem <- psem(
  body_cond_1_ALL,  
  body_cond_2_ALL, 
  body_cond_3_ALL,
  immune_system_ALL 
)
```


```{r, eval = FALSE}
summary(quadra_sem)
#NOTES:
#AFDM_g	increases with food (marginal), not much heat effect
#Gonadosomatic Ratio decreases with heat (sig), interaction suggests food may mitigate
#Righting decreases with heat (sig), decreases with high immune activity (sig)
#Coelomocyte Count increases with food & heat (strong), decreases with gonadal investment
```

### Removing independence claim that is invalid

```{r, eval=FALSE}
bs <- basisSet(quadra_sem)
bs$`1` <- NULL

dSep(quadra_sem, basis.set = bs)
fisherC(quadra_sem, basis.set = bs)
```

### Table S9

```{r, eval = FALSE}

Table_S9_raw <- summary(quadra_sem)$coefficients
colnames(Table_S9_raw)[9] <-  "stars"

Table_S9 <- Table_S9_raw %>%
  mutate(Std.Estimate = signif(Std.Estimate, 3),
         Estimate = signif(Estimate, 3),
         Std.Error = signif(Std.Error, 3),
         P.Value = signif(P.Value, 3),
         DF = signif(DF, 3),
         P.Value2 = paste(P.Value, stars, sep = " ")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Response, Predictor, Estimate, Std.Error, DF, P.Value2, 
                Std.Estimate)%>%
  rename(SE = Std.Error,
         P.Value = P.Value2)

write.csv(Table_S9, file = here("04_tables_figures", "Table_S9.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

```
